name: Gees Camp Site
beachAccess: About a three-minute walk to the beach
confirmedFeatures: Showers, toilets, small shop, Wi-Fi, electric hook-ups; open 1 March to 31 October
overview: A small campsite in East Wittering, about three minutes' walk from the beach and less than half a mile from Bracklesham Bay. It has 25 grass pitches, some with hook-ups, along with showers and a small shop.
surfTripFit: Walking distance to the beach, so you can check the sea and carry boards down.
